l01.text: A New Year print begins as a drawing, carved backwards into a plank of pear wood.

l03.text: Then comes colour, one block at a time.

l04.text: Peach for the skin. Yellow for the gold.

l05.text: Then green for the lotus. Indigo for the water.

l06.text: No block fits quite perfectly. That is the charm.

l07.text: Red goes last. A carp for surplus. A lotus for year after year.

l08.text: But a wish needs a guard.

l09.text: So one block is printed twice, and the pair face each other.

l12.text: The paper was only borrowed. The block stays on the bench.

subs.text: A New Year print begins as a drawing, carved backwards into a plank of pear wood.
Then comes colour, one block at a time.
Peach for the skin. Yellow for the gold.
Then green for the lotus. Indigo for the water.
No block fits quite perfectly. That is the charm.
Red goes last. A carp for surplus. A lotus for year after year.
But a wish needs a guard.
So one block is printed twice, and the pair face each other.
The paper was only borrowed. The block stays on the bench.
